purpose: Operational/automation layer for the hackathon submission: an OpenRouter async client + live LLM judge panels (frontier + local Ollama), real REINFORCE/Wordle training runs, EMDAT crisis-library cooking with real embeddings, live HF-Space rollouts, live API-key proofs (EIA/FRED/NASA FIRMS/NewsAPI/NOAA/GFW/W&B), CI-style claim verifiers (run_all.py, check_benchmarks.py), HF Space deploy scripts, and a long tail of "pass20â€“pass28" receipt-generator scripts plus 7 one-shot notebook patchers that mass-produce sha256-stamped JSON "receipts" and plots for judges.
verdict: This directory is two subsystems wearing one trenchcoat. Roughly a third is genuinely good engineering: openrouter_client.py is a properly rate-limited, key-hygienic async client; cook_v2.py builds a real 1500-event EMDAT library with real embeddings and deterministic severity rules; final_real_reinforce_wordle_v2.py and pass23/pass27-B/pass28-J run real gradient-update training with unusually honest masking-vs-learning ablations; pass26/27/28 live HF-Space rollouts and pass28 K1-K3 FRED/NewsAPI/NOAA ingests are verifiably live. But the other two-thirds is a receipt factory that repeatedly violates the owner's own "no synthetic, no fabrication" rule while loudly claiming to honor it: hardcoded RAP-XC eval stats presented as "recorded" data, Wilcoxon p-values of 1e-18 manufactured by sorting two independent synthetic samples and calling them "paired", conformal-coverage receipts computed on pure rng.normal noise labeled "split_conformal_NLL_vovk2005", a fabricated ascending reward curve logged to W&B as "live_dashboard_proof", an ONNX bundle shipping untrained random-weight models, an adversarial "gauntlet" that tests a copy of the defense logic inlined in the test itself, a receipt patcher that unconditionally sets key_authenticated=True, and a hand-crafted "concrete trajectory" whose Wordle feedback is factually wrong. On top of that, the two scripts that were supposed to be the judge-facing verification gates (run_all.py, check_benchmarks.py) plus 4 more are dead from the phase4 versions/ rename â€” check_benchmarks.py silently exits 0 with every check skipped, the worst possible failure mode for a regression guard. The real work here is drowning in evidence-inflation theater that would be fatal if a judge diffed any receipt against its generator.
